from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql = """WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        invoice.BillingCountry AS country,
        track.GenreId AS genre_id,
        genre.Name AS genre,
        CAST(SUM(
            CAST(ROUND(invoice_line.UnitPrice * 100, 0) AS INTEGER)
            * invoice_line.Quantity
        ) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_cents,
        CAST(SUM(invoice_line.Quantity) AS INTEGER) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS invoice
    INNER JOIN InvoiceLine AS invoice_line
        ON invoice_line.InvoiceId = invoice.InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN Track AS track
        ON track.TrackId = invoice_line.TrackId
    INNER JOIN Genre AS genre
        ON genre.GenreId = track.GenreId
    WHERE invoice.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND invoice.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        invoice.BillingCountry,
        track.GenreId,
        genre.Name
),
ranked_genres AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked_genres
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
"""
out=Path('/work/query.sql')
out.write_text(sql, encoding='utf-8')
print('wrote bytes', out.stat().st_size)

con=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
steps=[0]
def progress():
    steps[0]+=100
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress,100)
cur=con.execute(out.read_text())
print('columns', [d[0] for d in cur.description])
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('rows',len(rows),'vm steps approx',steps[0])
print('first 8',rows[:8])
print('types first', [con.execute('SELECT typeof(?)',(v,)).fetchone()[0] for v in rows[0]])
print('last 3',rows[-3:])
con.close()
